decisions.statement: A name reading as an id is refused.
A seat retaking the name the seat already has is allowed without any further test.
A name held by a seat with a process in the seat is refused unless the caller says to take the name.
A caller whose own seat has the name takes the name back without saying so.
Whether a name matches a declared shape is not judged here.
Nothing here writes the values a seat states.

definition: whether a seat may take the name it asks for
